title: Matrix scan and suffix property
statement: Let $x$ be a finite Boolean word, $B$ a natural number, $K$ a proposition, $i$ a natural number, and $\sigma$ a program register state whose nine register values are all at most $B$. Suppose $2|x|+2\le B$, the vertex-count register $n$ satisfies $n\le |x|$, the input pointer is $2n+2+2i$, the row register is $\lfloor i/n\rfloor$, the column register is the remainder of $i$ upon division by $n$, and $i\le n^2$. If the bit of $x$ at position $2n+2+2n^2+1$, using false for an out-of-range position, is true, and the path program started at label $sg$ with input pointer $2n+2+2n^2+2$, row register $n$, and column register $0$ satisfies $PS$ with proposition $K$, then the program started at label $m0$ with register state $\sigma$ satisfies $PS$ with proposition that $K$ holds and, for every $j$ with $i\le j<n^2$, the bits at positions $2n+2+2j$ and $2n+2+2j+1$ agree (out-of-range bits count as false), while the bits at positions $2n+2+2n^2$ and $2n+2+2n^2+1$ are false and true, respectively (again counting out-of-range bits as false).
hypotheses_covered: all nine register values of $\sigma$ are at most $B$
column register equals the remainder of $i$ upon division by $n$
the bit of $x$ at position $2n+2+2n^2+1$, defaulting to false out of range, is true
the specified $sg$-stage configuration satisfies $PS$ with proposition $K$
replaced:
Let $x$ be a bit string, $B$ a natural number, $K$ a proposition, $i$ a natural number,
and $σ$ a register configuration whose nine register values are all at most $B$. Suppose
$2|x|+2\le B$, $n\le |x|$, the input pointer is $2n+2+2i$, the row and column registers
are respectively $\lfloor i/n\rfloor$ and the remainder of $i$ upon division by $n$, and
$i\le n^2$. If the bit at position $2n+2+2n^2+1$ of $x$ is $1$, then starting the fixed
path program at the matrix-scan stage with input pointer $2n+2+2n^2+2$, row register
$n$, and column register $0$ terminates within the register bound and accepts exactly
when $K$ holds. Consequently, starting at the earlier matrix-processing stage with
configuration $σ$ terminates within the register bound and accepts exactly when both $K$
holds and every matrix entry from index $i$ through $n^2-1$ is represented by equal bits
in its aligned pair, with the following separator bits equal to $01$.
